reasoning_steps.description: Calculate the total number of ordered pairs in the Cartesian product S \times S.
Apply the reflexivity condition which requires all diagonal elements (i, i) to be in the relation.
Apply the symmetry condition which couples off-diagonal elements (i, j) and (j, i) for i \neq j.
Calculate the total number of valid relations by multiplying the number of choices for independent components.

educational_hint: Reflexive relations fix the diagonal entries, while symmetric relations treat off-diagonal entries as coupled pairs, reducing the degrees of freedom to the number of unique pairs.
cache_matched_question: 设$S$为$n$元集，求$S$上自反且对称的关系的个数。
